name: Eating Fish
overview: Scripture reveals that God granted humanity dominion over the fish of the sea as part of His creation mandate (Genesis 1:28). While Genesis 1:29 emphasizes plant-based provisions for food, Leviticus 11 clarifies dietary laws given to Israel, permitting the consumption of aquatic creatures only if they have fins and scales (Leviticus 11:9) and declaring those without these features as unclean (Leviticus 11:10). This distinction underscores God's sovereign authority in defining clean and unclean foods for His people.
